name: Alina Sokolova
source: A human who exists as a servant of Ladja in the Mtsyrei World. She was born without a right hand. Before Ladja bought her, she was illiterate, but her new mistress gave her a decent education (especially medicine). It was Alina who became the reason Ladja decided to create a new world in which she would be God.
